corrected_code:
from ninja import Router, Schema
from ninja.security import HttpBearer
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import WebhookEndpoint

class UpdateWebhookSchema(Schema):
    target_url: str
    is_active: bool
    event_types: list[str]

class WebhookResponseSchema(Schema):
    id: int
    target_url: str
    is_active: bool

router = Router(auth=HttpBearer())

@router.patch("/webhooks/{webhook_id}", response=WebhookResponseSchema)
def update_webhook(request, webhook_id: int, payload: UpdateWebhookSchema):
    webhook = get_object_or_404(
        WebhookEndpoint,
        id=webhook_id,
        organization=request.auth.organization
    )
    webhook.target_url = payload.target_url
    webhook.is_active = payload.is_active
    webhook.event_types = payload.event_types
    webhook.save()
    return webhook
